name: brutespray-canonical-attempt-observation-stream
instr:
brutespray cannot carry a canonical, secret-free observation through execution, output, persistence, replay, and presentation. Emit one per worker-visible result without changing successful-credential output or resume behavior.

Treat retries as linked, sequenced executions of one logical attempt. `(o AttemptObservation) Validate() error` rejects bad linkage and secret-bearing values. `NewAttemptStream() *AttemptStream` creates an ordered stream. `(s *AttemptStream) Publish(observation AttemptObservation) error` isolates subscriber failures. `(s *AttemptStream) Close() error` deterministically drains accepted work; later publication returns `ErrAttemptStreamClosed`, exactly `errors.New("attempt stream closed")`.

Drive reports, statistics, checkpoint resume, and legacy progress from deduplicated, non-retry observations. Report retries separately. Session history and `LoadAttemptObservations(filePath string) ([]AttemptObservation, error)` accept mixed legacy and canonical records, skip malformed records without losing later valid history, and deduplicate replayed sequences.

`NewJSONStore(dir)` supplies a `Store` preserving publication order and rejecting plaintext credentials before durable changes. Live and replayed host, service, success, error, and progress views must match. Host lifecycle events enclose each target observation.

Drain observations before completion and summaries. Keep cleanup idempotent, including after final-delivery subscriber failure, without blocking
